build_ngram_verify_input: build an NgramVerifyInput object with draft tokens, tree mask, positions, and retrieval indices for speculative decoding
run_ngram_verify: run ngram speculative decoding verification on a schedule batch with logits output and page size
prepare_verify_input: prepare an NgramVerifyInput for verification by allocating KV cache slots and setting batch input IDs
generate_attention_args: generate attention arguments for prefill phase including KV indices, cumulative sequence lengths, and tree mask
greedy_verify_draft_tokens: greedily verify draft tokens against target model logits and return accepted indices and predicted tokens
